report.clinical_summary: Freelance writer diagnosed with HIV 3 years ago, on Triumeq once daily. Reports fatigue (2 months) and headaches (2 weeks, 5/10). Viral load 340 copies/mL (detectable), CD4 410 cells/uL. Inconsistent adherence - sometimes misses doses, sometimes takes two at once, has taken drug holidays. Works from home, takes care of children, takes medication with breakfast around 8:00 AM. Identifies stress as potential contributor to symptoms. Views HIV as lifelong condition requiring consistent management.
